definitions.explanation: The act of writing, especially books, articles, or other substantial written works.

examples.japanese: {小説|しょうせつ}の{執筆|しっぴつ}に{専念|せんねん}している。
examples.english: I'm dedicating myself to writing a novel.

examples.japanese: この{記事|きじ}は{山田先生|やまだせんせい}が{執筆|しっぴつ}した。
examples.english: This article was written by Professor Yamada.

examples.japanese: {執筆|しっぴつ}{活動|かつどう}を{続|つづ}けている。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{執筆|しっぴつ}する (to write, to author)
・{執筆|しっぴつ}{者|しゃ} (author, writer)
・{執筆|しっぴつ}{活動|かつどう} (writing activities)
・{執筆|しっぴつ}{中|ちゅう} (in the process of writing)

USAGE NOTE:
{執筆|しっぴつ} is more formal than {書|か}く and implies serious writing work like books, articles, or academic papers. It's not used for casual writing like notes or text messages.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{著作|ちょさく} - written work, authorship
・{著述|ちょじゅつ} - writing (formal/literary)

[Register: Formal]
